consequence.statement: The Argo CD UI logo now links to the start page; this is a UI convenience feature with no operational impact on deployments or integrations

original.statement: The Argo CD UI now includes a link to the start page in the Argo logo.

decision.reason: [ev-a4f8422ce445] lists this under Changelog › Features as a purely additive UI change: the Argo logo now links to the start page. Nothing in it says anything fails, is rejected, stops being honoured or must be migrated. Existing behaviour doesn't change in a way an operator would need to check, so the informational kind "none" fits.
